title: Walk-through image review: agent sends one or many images for TJ to go through and comment on

requirements.text: An item can carry 1 or more image links, and the phone shows them as a set TJ can page through one at a time
requirements.check: Send an item with 1 image and one with 4; page through each set on the phone

requirements.text: TJ can comment on each image by voice or text, and each comment reaches the asking session tagged with that image
requirements.check: Comment on image 2 of 4 by voice and image 3 by text; check the session receives both, each naming its image

text: Built in 0.1.456703 (R2): items carry images (absolute image paths, up to 12); the bridge sends each as a file (fid ITEM-imgN) and names them on the item; the answer sheet pages through them (arrows, dots, 'next image' by voice), one comment per image; send returns each comment tagged 'Image N of M (name, caption)'. Tests: bridge e2e 14/14 incl. review, unit 53, phone 30. Tally rule added in Voice.swift (needs Tally restart). Next: TJ runs the 1- and 4-image test.

Test 1 at 03:57:48: Tally sent the 2-item review, 5 files reached the bridge->phone, but the reply was 'not walked' because my genlock-ask prompt counts as a laptop prompt (answers=laptop). Resent as a [phone] message (tell-1794628685237). Note: genlock ask assistant prompts also move the moved-on mark, same family as T-P3PEM.

03:58: both test sends reached the phone (5 files each) but neither was walked: TJ was typing to Tally outside the phone app (laptop/Remote Control), so replies count as read there. My [phone] tell was typed into the middle of his own typing ('when will t<paste>hat go through'), a Mac app delivery collision worth a ticket. Next: TJ asks for the test from the phone app.

Fixed: a reply carrying review images now walks on the phone even when it answers a laptop or session prompt (items.mjs walkable(), bridge 55/55, e2e 14/14). Bridge restarted 03:59:50 UTC. Asked Tally to resend the test.

evidence: 04:00:28 UTC on 0.1.456703: a 1-image item and a 4-image item reached the phone (5 files) and walked; TJ paged the set (bridge log 'review: image 2 of 4' at 04:01:23)

text: TJ's test 04:01: answers came back tagged ('Image 1 of 1 (84bd7b498ca9-3-walk.png): ...', 'Image 2 of 4 (genlock-mark-1024.png, logo mark): ...'). He did not do the typed comment on image 3, so req 2 stays open. His feedback: swipe between images, tap for full screen, pinch zoom. Building those.

0.1.456725 (R2): swipe between images in the sheet and full screen; tap (or the full-screen button) opens full screen with pinch zoom, pan when zoomed, double-tap 2.5x/reset; send on an image before the last keeps its comment and turns to the next (TJ: send on image 2 cleared all four); last image's send, 'finish review'/'send all', or the Finish review button sends the set. Focus Mode matches (installed, needs relaunch). Phone tests 31/31.

evidence: 04:11:19 UTC on 0.1.456725: Tally received 'Image 2 of 4 (genlock-mark-1024.png, logo mark): ... image 2 looks good' (spoken, send stepped to image 3 at 04:11:07) and 'Image 3 of 4 (64e330a73244-7fd3c038-image.png): amazon!!!' (typed), each tagged with its image, in one answer

text: 0.1.456733: Finish moved to the header (away from the swipe area) after TJ hit it by accident when the bottom controls shifted; hint line fixed at 2 lines; a spoken send that only turns the page happens at once with no countdown bar; '2 / 4' count drawn on the image (TJ couldn't see the count); send log says 'comment kept, next image'. 31 phone tests pass.

answers.observed: bridge log 04:00:28 and 04:09:44 UTC: 5 files sent and the 2-item review walked on 0.1.456703/0.1.456725; Tally's transcript 04:11:19: 'Image 2 of 4 (genlock-mark-1024.png, logo mark): ... image 2 looks good' (spoken) and 'Image 3 of 4 (64e330a73244-7fd3c038-image.png): amazon!!!' (typed)
answers.cause: measured: the tags come from WalkPlan.reviewAnswer, unit-tested, and match what Tally received
answers.absence: not tested: an image larger than the bridge's shrink size, a review over 4 images, or a session (not Tally) receiving the relayed comments; the 3-to-1 page jump at 04:10:41 is unexplained (dot tap or pager feedback)
answers.assumption: mine: Tally passes each tagged comment on to the session that asked; only Tally's side was observed
answers.falsify: a review where a comment arrives under the wrong image label, or swiping makes the page bounce without input
